```{r}
#| label: Identifiers

# Identifiers and Authors: shared by Metadata.qmd and Deposit_README.qmd (Ecology asks that they match exactly).

Keywords <- yaml::read_yaml("Suppfiles/abstract_keywords.yml")$keywords %>%
  str_split(",\\s*") %>% unlist() %>% str_trim() %>% discard(~ .x == "")
Authors_yml <- yaml::read_yaml("Suppfiles/authors.yml")
Affil <- map_chr(Authors_yml$affiliations, \(a) paste(na.omit(c(a$department, a$name, a$city, a$country)), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  set_names(map_chr(Authors_yml$affiliations, "id"))
Authors_md <- map_chr(Authors_yml$author, \(a) {
  aff <- paste(Affil[map_chr(a$affiliations, "ref")], collapse = "; ")
  paste0("- **author name:** ", str_trim(a$name), "  \n  **author ORCID:** [to be added]  \n",
         if (!is.null(a$email)) paste0("  **author email:** ", a$email, "  \n") else "",
         "  **author affiliation:** ", aff)
})
```
